question: Can bounded causal-delta contracts compose learned one-step interventions to predict previously unseen two-action trajectories?
hypothesis: Locally selected 0/1/2-parent causal-delta contracts learn sparse action effects and transfer compositionally across untrained two-action sequences, outperforming tabular full-state and one-parent models, with cold retention and no spurious null-world parents.
predecessor_evidence: CCE02 result 0.87578125 tied strongest table, prereg d32644ef28d120e80351f24d0ace59f666996cde
CI run 45158300762 G29 indexed set fail; not a science failure

inputs.name: positive sparse 6-bit action world
inputs.source: Public 6 binary state bits, actions 0/1/2, deterministic concurrent XOR-delta rules of at most two other state-bit parents. Ground truth solely in evaluator, never passed as learner rules or variable labels.

inputs.name: null action world
inputs.source: Same public state/action generator; actions do not change any state bit. Negative selection control.

frozen_design.split: Per seed/world, 768 independent public one-step transitions, x=randrange(64) and action=randrange(3) from random.Random(seed). Evaluation 384 fresh two-step sequences, x=randrange(64), a=randrange(3), b=randrange(3) from independent random.Random(seed+300000). No two-step training or evaluation updating.
frozen_design.ordering: Each hypothesis predicts before consuming observed next state. Freeze 18 selected local mechanisms after 768 transitions based only on training prequential losses; test on heldout initial states and action pairs without updates.
frozen_design.data_budget: 2 worlds x 5 seeds x (768 one-step training + 384 two-step evaluation) = 11520 episodes total, 7680 training examples and 3840 two-step evaluations. One primary execution, no search.
frozen_design.compute_budget: Python stdlib CPU only. Each trained candidate maintains 16 fixed possible parent subsets per target/action, no unbudgeted extra models/APIs; comparator cost separately reported, no compute-efficiency claim.
frozen_design.capacity: 6 bits, 3 actions, 18 target-action slots. 16 candidate parents per slot: empty, five singleton, ten pairs of other bits; Beta(1,1) flip counts; at most two parents selected; fixed bounded slots.
frozen_design.selection_rule: Choose min cumulative prequential Brier + 0.5*(2**k)*log2(1+N_a), k=parent count, tie to shorter then lexicographic. Predict delta_i = old_i XOR new_i; flip predicted bit only when selected conditional posterior >0.5.
controls: Same-data full-state action-conditional Beta(1,1) per-bit delta table
Same-data 0/1 parent prequential selection with identical penalty
Same-data pooled action-conditional per-bit delta table
Oracle source model scored solely as evaluator ceiling, not eligible matched control
Null world zero action effects; all 18 slots should prefer zero parents
Corrupted/forged snapshot and invalid-event negative tests
metrics: Two-step exact 6-bit state accuracy per seed
Selected parent sets and counts of nonempty null-world parents
Exact cold restore predictions over all 64x3 possible public one-step inputs
Serialized bytes, trained counters and wall-clock diagnostic
Strongest matched trained control plus full seed-level results

classification_rules.supported: DEVELOPMENT_SIGNAL only if mean positive-world CCE03 two-step full-state accuracy >=0.80 and >= strongest learned baseline +0.10, all 5 null-world seeds select 0 parents in all 18 slots, and 5/5 exact cold restore for all 64x3 predictions. Not SCIENTIFIC_PASS.
classification_rules.mixed: Any improvement over a learned baseline with a missed support criterion, or recovered causal parents without strongest-control advantage. Report complete per-seed negatives.
classification_rules.negative: Valid run with no advantage or repeated false parents. Preserve without post-result tuning.
classification_rules.invalid: Source/first-use drift; hidden rules leaked into learner; heldout reuse in selection; changed frozen budgets, seeds, evaluator, threshold; missing source/negative controls; tamper accepted; unauthorized runner.

prohibited_after_primary_run: extra seeds, compute, hidden labels or search
post-result tuning and repeat primary run
preregistration_note: Freeze separate experiment identity before code or outcome. Existing G29 atlas CI remains a qualification blocker, never bypassed.
